Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics

Class CosmeticDefinition

java.lang.Object
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticDefinition
public final class CosmeticDefinition extends Object
One cosmetic of an addon's type, as its handler lists it. Immutable; build one with builder(String).

Who may use it:

  • a player who owns it, granted or bought;
  • a player who holds its permission, when it has one;
  • everyone, when it is unlocked by default.
One with a price can be bought with Zentrix's currency by players who cannot use it yet. 

 CosmeticDefinition crown = CosmeticDefinition.builder("crown")
     .name("&6Golden Crown")
     .icon(new ItemStack(Material.GOLDEN_HELMET))
     .lore(List.of("&7Fit for a champion."))
     .rarity("&6Legendary")
     .price(2500)
     .build();
